mods.name: Chunk Back
mods.description: One-shot compressed voxel snapshots. Save chunk regions and restore them with zero lag. By I is evil duck.

releases.notes:
Initial release.

## Features
- RLE-compressed voxel snapshots save chunk regions to disk
- Tick-safe restore: 16,000 blocks/tick, no server lag
- Bulk client updates via ClientboundSectionBlocksUpdatePacket
- Commands: save, savearea, restore, list, delete, info

## Fixes in this release
- Fixed Y/Z coordinate swap in restore (blocks were placed at wrong heights)
- Fixed UUID mismatch that caused all snapshots to be lost on world reload
- Fixed partial-section flush loss during tick-batched restore
- Fixed 'failed to load resource pack' error (missing pack.mcmeta)
- Fixed Gradle compatibility (ForgeGradle 6.x requires Gradle 8.x)

readmeSummary: A Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 mod for saving and restoring chunk regions with zero lag and zero RAM bloat.
